chapter: Return to Chicago: the Blue Note and Rupneck's
title: Trouble with Zutty Singleton
summary: Hodes, now sober, clashes with Zutty. They stop speaking.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money

blocks.x: What it did to me was, I got zutty. Now, last time I worked with zutty was on Decca Records. And zutty and I were very together. But now, here I'm not drinking, I'm not smoking, I'm not -- very straight kick. And probably not playing as good, because it takes a while to start -- if you've been playing high and drunk all the time, you get sober, not drink and not get high, it's going to take you a while to find your way around. And that I have to admit, I can't fault nobody.

The other end of the stick is, zutty is way out. I'm not talking about him smoking pot. I mean, he's out there, he's doing something. If it's that much off, a hairline off, it bothers him. Just -- or the tempo or the way I'm playing. And we were not together, right from the start.
